title: Dictionaries and Sets
description: Store key-value pairs with O(1) lookups and perform fast mathematical set operations.

blocks.content:
Searching a list of 1,000,000 items line by line takes O(n) time - if the item is at the end, Python checks every single element.

Python's **Dictionaries (`dict`)** and **Sets (`set`)** are backed by **hash tables**, allowing near-instantaneous $O(1)$ constant time lookups regardless of how large the dataset is.

## Dictionaries (`dict`)

Stores associative key-value pairs. Keys must be **hashable/immutable** (strings, numbers, tuples):

```python
user = {"name": "Jordan", "role": "engineer", "level": 3}

# Safe access with .get(key, default)
email = user.get("email", "no-email@statica.com")

# Iterating
for key, value in user.items():
    print(f"{key}: {value}")
```

## Sets (`set`)

An unordered collection of **unique** elements with mathematical set operations:

```python
frontend_devs = {"Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"}
backend_devs = {"Bob", "Diana", "Charlie"}

# Union (all unique developers)
all_devs = frontend_devs | backend_devs  # {'Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie', 'Diana'}

# Intersection (full-stack devs working on both)
full_stack = frontend_devs & backend_devs  # {'Bob', 'Charlie'}

# Difference (only frontend)
frontend_only = frontend_devs - backend_devs  # {'Alice'}
```

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["Frontend: Alice, Bob, Charlie"] --- B["Intersection (&): Bob, Charlie"]
    C["Backend: Bob, Diana, Charlie"] --- B
```

blocks.question: What happens when you execute `my_set = {1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3}`?
options: A SyntaxError is raised due to duplicate keys
my_set converts numbers to string keys
blocks.explanation: Sets automatically deduplicate their elements upon creation, leaving only `{1, 2, 3}`.

blocks.starterCode:
inventory = {"apples": 10, "oranges": 5, "bananas": 12}

# Update quantity safely
inventory["apples"] = inventory.get("apples", 0) + 5

# Unique fruit categories
categories = set(inventory.keys())
print("Current stock:", inventory)
print("Unique categories:", categories)
